plugins.name: FaaUpdater
plugins.description: Manages installation and updates for FascinaTe phBot plugins from the trusted GitHub catalog.
changes: Changelog tracking started for the current version.

plugins.name: FAutoCaptcha
plugins.description: Automatically captures and periodically replays MaxiGuard's server-specific 0xC011 packet.
changes: Added a prominent GUI notice and documentation stating that the plugin is intended only for MaxiGuard-protected servers.

plugins.name: FAutoGS
plugins.description: Coordinates guild-storage scripts across party characters.
changes: Changelog tracking started for the current version.

plugins.name: FAutoHWT
plugins.description: Automates repeatable solo and party HWT runs from entry through dungeon completion, exit, and final return to normal botting.
changes: Added Solo, Party Leader, and Party Member modes for complete HWT automation.
Added selectable Slot Profile, HWT Profile, leader HWT route, leader return route, difficulty, teleport language, and run count settings.
Added city-to-gate and manual `Start From Gate` flows with gate NPC, region, distance, roster, leader, and stability validation.
Added leader-first entry, FControl trace coordination, an eight-second member fallback, and leader-only dungeon route execution.
Added repeat-run handling with leader return-to-gate routing, member leave-party exit, and final Slot Profile, Return Scroll, town verification, and optional bot restart.
Added Daily, Selected days, and One time scheduling with missed-trigger tolerance.
Added immediate HWT entry-limit detection for the verified `0xB05A 02 27 1C` server response.
Entry-limited or timed-out members remain outside while successfully entered characters complete the current run; the cycle then finalizes without attempting another HWT entry.
Added versioned private coordination, bounded retries and timeouts, detailed diagnostic logging, and backward-compatible loading of legacy `FHWTGate` settings and scripts.
Refined the two-screen interface to fit the measured phBot viewport without overlapping controls.
Fixed the leader HWT route failing to start after the FControl trace delay.
Fixed party members incorrectly requiring and starting their own HWT route scripts.

plugins.name: FAutoPetClock
plugins.description: Monitors Pick Pets and safely renews expired or expiring pets with available clocks.
changes: Stopped unrelated item-use replies from filling the log, including while monitoring is disabled or paused.
Limited repeated monitoring errors and summon-test blocking warnings to one message per category every 60 seconds.
Added an optional source-level packet debug switch, disabled by default, for Clock and summon-test diagnostics.

plugins.name: FAutoUnique V2
plugins.description: Hunts unique monsters through prioritized script or learned coordinate routes.
changes: Added `Get Coord from Server` in Hunt Settings to import all supported outdoor unique coordinates from the active server's Media DB3 in one click, without selecting a unique. Points are converted to game coordinates and saved per character, preserving existing points and skipping same-region duplicates within 30 meters.
Added an import summary and per-unique logs showing newly added points and saved totals, including matches with no new points on repeat imports.

Added a destination selector and `Copy Coordinates to Unique` in the Coordinate Editor to copy missing points to another unique while preserving existing points, skipping same-region duplicates within 30 meters, and leaving the source and route preferences unchanged.

plugins.name: FCaravanNavigator V3
plugins.description: Navigates caravan routes and recovers interrupted travel.
changes: Added Samarkand and Constantinople to the town destinations.
Added self-issued `!GO <code>`, `!GO LIST`, and `!GO STOP` chat commands for navigation control.
Added validation for unique destination codes used by chat commands.
Fixed the Taklamakan Special button appearing below the visible plugin area after adding the new town destinations.

plugins.name: FChamberViciousShadows
plugins.description: Coordinates party entry, combat, exit, and repeat runs for the Vicious Shadows dungeon.
changes: Changelog tracking started for the current version.

plugins.name: FCharacterPluginManager
plugins.description: Loads a separate set of local phBot plugins for each server and character.
changes: Added per-server and per-character plugin selection with automatic in-memory loading.
Added support for managed single-file plugins and plugin folders.
Added event forwarding, packet return handling, GUI callback isolation, and plugin cleanup.
Added a GUI for scanning, selecting, saving, and applying managed plugins.

plugins.name: FControl
plugins.description: Remotely controls phBot characters through authorized in-game chat commands and synchronized actions.
changes: Fixed generic `USE` commands on locale 65 servers by sending the manually verified expanded four-byte item type.

plugins.name: FDevilAwakener
plugins.description: Automatically applies Awakening Enhancement Scrolls to an inventory or equipped Devil's Spirit until it reaches the requested enhancement level.
changes: Fixed equipped-only mode incorrectly searching normal `get_inventory()` slot 4 for a Devil that phBot does not expose until it is unequipped.
Fixed unequip destination handling by treating the successful `0xB034` destination as authoritative instead of deriving it from the request's changing final byte.
Added post-unequip item verification so scrolls are used only after the item appearing in the reported inventory slot is confirmed as a supported Devil; other avatar items are restored immediately.

plugins.name: FEventAutomation
plugins.description: Automatically exchanges supported event items through Event So-Ok and opens Silkroad Boxes.
changes: Fixed Pledge of Love leaving Event So-Ok open by applying the same close and event-cleanup packet sequence used by Jewel Box automation.

plugins.name: FExchangeManager
plugins.description: Automatically accepts exchange requests from trusted nearby players or optionally from all nearby guild members.
changes: Reworked the item-filter layout into separate manual-entry and inventory-selection rows with a wider item selector, dedicated add actions, and non-overlapping controls.

plugins.name: FFateManager
plugins.description: Automatically applies Wheel of Fate until each queued equipment item reaches its configured blue-line count.
changes: Excluded the response's internal magic-option record from the visible blue-line count.

plugins.name: FFortuneManager
plugins.description: Automatically rolls eligible equipment until every configured per-stat line target is reached.
changes: Added context-aware decoding for the live-verified high-degree weapon code family (`0x69`, `0x6A`, `0x6B`, `0x6C`, `0x6D`, `0x77`) without changing armor/accessory interpretations of overlapping codes.

plugins.name: FInventoryManager
plugins.description: Sorts character inventory and personal storage with configurable category rules.
changes: Fixed iSRO Personal Storage session detection when the client sends the NPC `0x704B` transition before the matching `0x7046` storage-talk packet.

plugins.name: FPenManager
plugins.description: Automatically applies Feather Pen of Fortune until each queued equipment item reaches its configured total stat values.
changes: Added response-driven Feather Pen of Fortune automation with independent minimum total values for each selected stat.
Added summation of repeated stat lines, multi-item queuing, inventory-slot validation, and automatic progression between completed items.
Added verified decoding of the changed stat key, old and new values, and the complete current stat record section from `0xB151` responses.
Added a one-roll test and a two-page GUI with live result and automation status indicators.

plugins.name: FPvpHelperV2
plugins.description: Switches configured weapons, shields, and skill groups during PvP.
changes: Changelog tracking started for the current version.

plugins.name: FScriptHelper
plugins.description: Records NPC interactions and replays them from phBot scripts.
changes: Restored NPC verification for the first recorded selection; unknown targets and unavailable NPC data now leave recording waiting for a valid NPC instead of creating a raw-UID recording.

plugins.name: FSereness
plugins.description: Detects boss petrification and temporarily moves the character to avoid it.
changes: Changelog tracking started for the current version.

plugins.name: FShining
plugins.description: Automates lightstone crafting and required material-stack splitting.
changes: Changelog tracking started for the current version.

plugins.name: FSilkroadBox
plugins.description: Opens Silkroad Boxes automatically from selected inventory pages in sequential or random order.
changes: Added automatic discovery and opening of `ITEM_PRE_MALL_SILKROAD_BOX` items.
Added inventory page selection for all available pages or one specific page.
Added sequential and random opening modes.
Added a configurable opening delay with a default of 250 ms.
Added live progress, activity logging, manual stop, and disconnect-safe cancellation.

plugins.name: FSroRAutoTrade
plugins.description: Automatically starts and manages trade runs when the configured Specialty Goods Box target is reached.
changes: Increased the caravan-script completion timeout from 30 to 90 minutes for long trade routes.

plugins.name: FTarget
plugins.description: Sends a configurable key combination and follow-up key through hotkey, chat, or timed-loop triggers.
changes: Fixed the party-message settings and save button being clipped below the visible phBot plugin area.
Reorganized the right panel so every interactive control remains visible at common display scaling levels.

plugins.name: FUniqueNotifier
plugins.description: Notifies you when configured unique monsters appear.
changes: Changelog tracking started for the current version.

plugins.name: FWheelManager
plugins.description: Combines Fate, Fortune, and Pen equipment rolling into one safely coordinated phBot plugin.
changes: Fixed Fortune rejecting responses containing the verified leading metadata record as an unknown stat, while preserving validation of other unknown records.
